title: Ambassadors of Reconciliation
reflectionText: Paul holds groaning and courage together: mortality awaits life, faith guides the present walk, and every person will appear before Christ. The love of Christ then sends reconciled people as ambassadors of reconciliation. Which part of that balanced hope speaks most directly to present anxiety?
editorialNotes: Packet 013 writer output. The retelling keeps 2 Corinthians 5’s heavenly dwelling, judgment seat, new creation, and ambassador language together without minimizing accountability or reducing reconciliation to a single slogan.
